title: FDA GenAI device comments
description: Comments close on FDA’s proposed approach to generative-AI medical devices.

title: GSA AI procurement clause
description: Part 552 deviation, including GSA’s LLM data-safeguarding clause, takes effect for covered acquisitions.

title: New Jersey AI hearing
description: Assembly hearing on AI and society; four bills for discussion only. Trenton, 1 p.m. EDT.

title: AI policing and civil rights
description: Federal advisory committee public briefing on discrimination and privacy; online, 3–5 p.m. Central.

title: EU global AI initiatives
description: Council working-party briefing on global AI initiatives; Brussels, 4 p.m. local. Delegates’ meeting.

title: AI loads and grid reliability
description: FERC technical conference on reliability, including AI compute campuses; Washington and webcast, 10 a.m.–2:40 p.m. EDT.

title: California AI-threat hearing
description: Senate informational hearing on AI threats; Sacramento, 9 a.m. local.

title: AI chatbot liability
description: NYU forum on social-media and AI-chatbot litigation; New York, 1:10–2:25 p.m. Not open to the public.

title: Canada Senate AI hearing
description: Senate AI-impact study, with Minister Evan Solomon listed to appear; Ottawa and videoconference, 10:30 a.m. Eastern. Subject to change.

title: GenAI discovery and evidence
description: Sedona sessions on discovery, admissibility and privilege; New Orleans. Working-group membership required.

title: AI rights and accountability
description: NYU COMPASS conference on legal status, corporate liability and regulation; New York. Registration required.

title: AI and the law
description: Conference on AI in legal practice, ethics and justice; Haub Law, White Plains, New York.

title: Italy AI decree in force
description: Italy’s Decree No. 179 implementing the EU AI Act enters into force, including IVASS supervision of high-risk insurance AI.

title: USA Today plaintiffs' stay response due
description: Deadline for the USA Today plaintiffs to explain why their case should not be stayed in the OpenAI copyright MDL; defendants' response due November 6.

title: EU copyright consultation closes
description: Commission targeted consultation on copyright reform, including AI training use, closes.

title: Colorado AG ADMT and chatbot rules comments
description: Reported close of formal comments on proposed rules under SB 26-189 and HB 26-1263; may extend if the hearing runs later.
